name: Lost Sheep Cafe
source:
Welcome to the Lost Sheep Café! A place where those who find themselves lost can go to rest.

On a snowy night Kai and Amelia find themselves in the Café. What will they learn about themselves and about how they see the world.

This game was originally made for the 2022 Winter Game Jam.

[From [url=https://peanutpiano.itch.io/lost-sheep-cafe]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎光临迷途羔羊咖啡馆！这里是供迷失方向之人休憩的港湾。

在一个飘雪的夜晚，凯和阿米莉亚来到了这家咖啡馆。他们将会对自身以及自己看待世界的方式产生怎样的认识呢？

本作最初为2022年冬季游戏创作赛而制作。

[引自[url=https://peanutpiano.itch.io/lost-sheep-cafe]Itch.io[/url]]
